body.style: margin: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100vh; overflow: auto;
body.script:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Mac OS in web!</title>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lexend:wght@300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Material+Icons|Material+Icons+Round">
  <!-- Preload default + popular wallpapers for faster first paint & switching -->
  <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/background/iridescence.jpg" fetchpriority="high">
  <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/background/2.jpg">
  <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kiralabs/macos-wallpapers/main/modern-macos/11.0-big-sur-day.jpeg">
  <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kiralabs/macos-wallpapers/main/modern-macos/10.15-catalina-day.jpeg">
  <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kiralabs/macos-wallpapers/main/modern-macos/10.14-mojave-day.jpeg">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net" crossorigin>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com" crossorigin>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://vscode.dev" crossorigin>


  <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-1.12.4.js"></script>
  <script src="https://code.jquery.com/ui/1.12.1/jquery-ui.js"></script>

  <style>
    :root {
      --color-white: #fff;
      --color-white-100: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      --color-white-200: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      --color-white-400: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
      --color-white-900: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      --color-black: #1e1e1e;
      --color-black-100: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
      --color-black-500: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      --color-blue-800: #007ff7;
      --app-color-white: rgb(252, 255, 251);
      --color-red: rgba(255, 2, 2, 0.788);
      --color-green: #11dd4e;
    }

    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; border: 0; list-style: none; box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      height: 100vh;
      user-select: none;
      font-family: "Lexend", sans-serif;
      background-color: #0f172a;
      background-image: none;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-attachment: fixed;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: default;
    }
    /* macOS-style cursors */
    a, button, .icon, .leftLi, .steam-tab, .steam-nav button,
    .lib-game, .game-tile, .featured-card, .cta, .cta-sm,
    .steam-footer-bar span, .open_Search, .battery, .clock,
    .child-launchpad, input[type="search"] {
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    input, textarea, [contenteditable="true"] {
      cursor: text;
    }
    .window, .steam, .calculator {
      cursor: default;
    }
    .window__taskbar, .steam .window__taskbar {
      cursor: default;
    }
    .ui-draggable-dragging {
      cursor: grabbing !important;
    }

    #loading {
      width: 100%; height: 100vh; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
      background: #000; z-index: 9999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: white; font-size: 22px;
    }

    /* ===== NAVBAR ===== */
    .navbar {
      width: 100%; padding: 0.1rem 0; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
      color: var(--color-white-900);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; z-index: 20;
      box-shadow: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }
    .navbar > ul { display: flex; align-items: center; }
    .navbar li {
      position: relative; font-size: 14px; margin: 0 4px; cursor: pointer;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.288); transition: 0.2s;
    }
    .navbar .leftLi { padding: 4px 8px; }
    .navbar .leftLi:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 5px; }
    li.app_name { display: none; font-weight: 900 !important; }

    li > ul {
      display: none; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 100%; margin-top: 1px;
      padding: 4px; min-width: 200px; background: var(--color-white-400);
      backdrop-filter: blur(11px); border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,0.36);
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    li:hover > ul { display: flex; }
    li > ul > li { width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15); padding-bottom: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; }
    li > ul > li:last-child { border: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    li > ul > li > button {
      color: white; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-family: "Lexend"; font-weight: 100;
      padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    li > ul > li > button:hover { background: var(--color-blue-800); }

    .navbar__right li { margin: 0 10px; }
    .navbar__right .battery {
      display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .navbar__right .battery.selected { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .navbar__right .battery__container {
      width: 22px; height: 10px; padding: 1px; position: relative; border-radius: 3px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .navbar__right .battery__container::after {
      content: ""; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); width: 3px; height: 7px;
      position: absolute; top: 50%; right: -5px; transform: translateY(-50%);
      border-top-right-radius: 3px; border-bottom-right-radius: 3px;
    }
    .navbar__right .battery__progress { height: 100%; background: white; border-radius: 2px; }
    .navbar__right .battery__text { font-size: 12px; margin-right: 4px; }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup {
      position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px); right: 0; opacity: 0; width: 220px;
      transition: 0.2s; padding: 4px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(60px); border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup.opened { opacity: 1; }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 10px; }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup header h3 { font-size: 16px; }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup header span { opacity: 0.75; font-size: 12px; }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup p { font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px; padding: 0 10px; }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup hr { margin: 6px 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup button {
      padding: 4px 10px; color: white; width: 100%; text-align: left; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .navbar__right .battery__popup button:hover { background: var(--color-blue-800); }

    /* ===== DOCK - Matching original repo magnification ===== */
    .dock {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      position: fixed;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem 0.4rem 0.5rem;
      bottom: 2.5%;
      left: 50%;
      height: 70px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-white-200);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.555);
      z-index: 10;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    }

    .dock .point {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: #f08080;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -2px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }

    .dock .column {
      width: 1px;
      height: 45px;
      margin: 0 6px;
      background: var(--color-white-400);
      align-self: center;
    }

    .dock .icon {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
      margin: 0 1px;
      height: 100%;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .dock .icon img {
      width: 3.6rem;
      height: 3.6rem;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
      transform: translateY(-2.5px);
      border-radius: 12px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35));
    }

    /* Main hover – matches original repo */
    .dock .icon:hover img {
      width: 7.1rem;
      height: 7.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
    }

    /* Neighbor icons scale (left & right) – matches original */
    .dock .icon:hover + .icon img {
      width: 5.6rem;
      height: 5.6rem;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .dock .icon:has(+ .icon:hover) img {
      width: 5.6rem;
      height: 5.6rem;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .dock .icon img:active {
      filter: brightness(0.7) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #2c2c2c);
    }

    /* ===== WINDOWS ===== */
    .container__Window {
      width: 100%; height: 90%; justify-content: space-around; align-items: center; display: none;
    }
    .window {
      display: none; min-width: 50%; max-width: 80%; height: 430px; overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 20px 30px var(--color-black-500);
      border: 1px solid #ffffff34; z-index: 10; touch-action: none;
      position: absolute;
    }
    /* Proper maximize — fills desktop under menu bar */
    .window.is-maximized,
    .steam.is-maximized,
    .settings-window.is-maximized,
    .safari.is-maximized,
    .Vscode.is-maximized,
    .calculator.is-maximized {
      position: fixed !important;
      top: 28px !important;
      left: 0 !important;
      right: 0 !important;
      bottom: 0 !important;
      width: 100vw !important;
      height: calc(100vh - 28px) !important;
      min-width: 0 !important;
      max-width: none !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;
      max-height: none !important;
      border-radius: 0 !important;
      border-left: none !important;
      border-right: none !important;
      border-bottom: none !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      transform: none !important;
      z-index: 45 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .window.is-maximized .window__taskbar,
    .settings-window.is-maximized .window__taskbar,
    .safari.is-maximized .window__taskbar,
    .Vscode.is-maximized .window__taskbar {
      border-radius: 0;
    }
    /* Green button looks "maximized" when active */
    .window.is-maximized .full::after,
    .window.is-maximized .full-Vscode::after,
    .window.is-maximized .full-note::after,
    .window.is-maximized .full-map::after,
    .window.is-maximized .full-settings::after,
    .window.is-maximized .full-safari::after,
    .steam.is-maximized .full-steam::after {
      /* subtle visual: smaller square when maximized */
    }
    .steam.maximized {
      position: fixed !important;
      top: 28px !important;
      left: 0 !important;
      width: 100vw !important;
      height: calc(100vh - 28px) !important;
      min-width: 0 !important;
      max-width: none !important;
      border-radius: 0 !important;
      z-index: 45 !important;
    }
    .window__taskbar {
      height: 38px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 14px;
      background-color: var(--app-color-white); align-items: center;
    }
    .window__taskbar--actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .window__taskbar--actions button {
      width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; transition: 0.3s;
    }
    .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(1) { background: #ff5f56; }
    .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(2) { background: #ffbd2e; }
    .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(3) { background: #27c93f; }
    .window__taskbar--content h2 { color: var(--color-black); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; }

    /* ===== STEAM WINDOW ===== */
    .window.steam {
      min-width: 78%;
      max-width: 95%;
      width: 920px;
      height: 580px;
      background: #1b2838;
      border: 1px solid #2a475e;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar {
      background: #171a21;
      height: 32px;
      padding: 0 0 0 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--content {
      flex: 1;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--content h2 {
      color: #c7d5e0;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-family: "Inter", "Motiva Sans", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    }
    /* Window controls on the RIGHT */
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
      margin-left: auto;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button,
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(1),
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(2),
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(3) {
      width: 46px !important;
      height: 32px !important;
      border-radius: 0 !important;
      border: none;
      padding: 0;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent !important;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.12s;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1) !important;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam:hover {
      background: #e81123 !important;
    }
    /* Minimize dash */
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.backfull-steam::after {
      content: "";
      width: 10px;
      height: 1px;
      background: #c7d5e0;
    }
    /* Maximize square */
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.full-steam::after {
      content: "";
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border: 1px solid #c7d5e0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    /* Close X */
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam::before,
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 12px;
      height: 1px;
      background: #c7d5e0;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam::before {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam::after {
      transform: rotate(-45deg);
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam:hover::before,
    .steam .window__taskbar--actions button.close-steam:hover::after {
      background: #fff;
    }
    .steam.minimized {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .steam.maximized {
      min-width: 98% !important;
      max-width: 98% !important;
      width: 98% !important;
      height: 92% !important;
      top: 40px !important;
      left: 1% !important;
    }
    .steam-content {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #1b2838;
      font-family: "Inter", "Motiva Sans", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      color: #c7d5e0;
      height: calc(100% - 32px);
      min-height: 0;
      position: relative;
    }
    .steam-store .steam-body {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .steam-topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: #171a21;
      height: 40px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      gap: 24px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .steam-topbar .steam-logo {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #c7d5e0;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin-right: 8px;
    }
    .steam-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      height: 100%;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .steam-nav button {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: #c7d5e0;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .steam-nav button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #fff; }
    .steam-nav button.active {
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #66c0f4;
    }
    .steam-user {
      margin-left: auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #c7d5e0;
    }
    .steam-user .avatar {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #66c0f4, #1b2838);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .steam-subnav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: #2a475e;
      height: 36px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .steam-subnav a, .steam-subnav span {
      color: #c7d5e0;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px 0;
    }
    .steam-subnav a:hover { color: #fff; }
    .steam-search {
      margin-left: auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: #316282;
      border-radius: 3px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .steam-search input {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 12px;
      width: 160px;
      outline: none;
    }
    .steam-search input::placeholder { color: #8f98a0; }
    .steam-body {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      position: relative;
    }
    .steam-store {
      display: none;
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .steam-store.active {
      display: flex;
    }
    .steam-library {
      display: none;
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      flex-direction: row;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .steam-library.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* Fix: detail/play are siblings of library — hide library fully when showing them */
    .steam-content > .steam-library.has-detail,
    .steam-content > .steam-library.has-playing {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .steam-content > .steam-detail-view.active {
      display: flex !important;
      flex: 1 1 auto !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .steam-content > .steam-play-view.active {
      display: flex !important;
      position: absolute !important;
      top: 40px;
      left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 28px;
      z-index: 50;
      background: #0e1621;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* Store hero */
    .steam-hero {
      position: relative;
      height: 280px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0d1b2a 0%, #1b2838 40%, #0d1b2a 100%);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .steam-hero img.hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0.55;
    }
    .steam-hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 20px;
    }
    .steam-hero-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      background: #66c0f4;
      color: #1b2838;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .steam-hero-badge span {
      background: #000;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      margin-left: 6px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .steam-hero h1 {
      font-size: 28px;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 8px 0;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    .steam-hero .cta {
      display: inline-block;
      background: #fff;
      color: #1b2838;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 8px 20px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    /* Featured */
    .steam-section {
      padding: 18px 24px;
    }
    .steam-section h3 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .featured-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .featured-card {
      flex: 0 0 340px;
      background: #16202d;
      border-radius: 4px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    }
    .featured-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    }
    .featured-card .cover {
      width: 180px;
      height: 160px;
      object-fit: cover;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .featured-card .info {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .featured-card .info h4 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .featured-card .info .reviews {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #66c0f4;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .featured-card .info .tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }
    .featured-card .info .tag {
      background: rgba(102,192,244,0.15);
      color: #66c0f4;
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .featured-card .info .price {
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #beee11;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .featured-card .info .free {
      color: #beee11;
    }
    /* Library */
    .lib-sidebar {
      width: 220px;
      background: #171a21;
      border-right: 1px solid #000;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .lib-sidebar-header {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #8f98a0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #2a475e;
    }
    .lib-search {
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #2a475e;
    }
    .lib-search input {
      width: 100%;
      background: #316282;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 3px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 12px;
      outline: none;
    }
    .lib-games {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 6px 0;
    }
    .lib-game {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #c7d5e0;
      transition: background 0.1s;
    }
    .lib-game:hover, .lib-game.active {
      background: rgba(102,192,244,0.15);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .lib-game .icon-sm {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #2a475e;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .lib-game .icon-sm img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }
    .lib-game .lib-game-title {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .lib-game {
      padding: 5px 12px;
    }
    .lib-main {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: #1b2838;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .lib-section {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .lib-section h3 {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .lib-section h3 span {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #8f98a0;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    .whats-new-row, .recent-row, .all-games-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .game-tile {
      flex: 0 0 160px;
      background: #16202d;
      border-radius: 4px;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.15s;
    }
    .game-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .game-tile .cover {
      width: 100%;
      height: 75px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: #0e1621;
    }
    .game-tile .meta {
      padding: 8px 10px;
    }
    .game-tile .meta .title {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #fff;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .game-tile .meta .sub {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: #8f98a0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .game-tile.playable .play-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: #2EBA42;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      margin: 6px 8px 8px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      width: fit-content;
    }
    .banner-strip {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1a3a5c, #2a475e);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-top: 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .banner-strip .left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .banner-strip .cta-sm {
      background: #66c0f4;
      color: #1b2838;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      font-size: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    #steam-all-tiles {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      max-height: calc(100% - 40px);
    }
    #steam-all-tiles .game-tile {
      flex: 0 0 140px;
    }

    /* Game detail page (Steam-like) */
    .steam-detail-view {
      display: none;
      flex: 1;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: #1b2838;
      color: #c7d5e0;
    }
    .steam-detail-view.active {
      display: flex;
    }
    .steam-library.active.has-detail .lib-sidebar,
    .steam-library.active.has-detail #steam-lib-main,
    .steam-library.active.has-playing .lib-sidebar,
    .steam-library.active.has-playing #steam-lib-main,
    .steam-library.active.has-playing .steam-detail-view {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-hero {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 280px;
      background: #0e1621 center/cover no-repeat;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .steam-detail-hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, #1b2838 0%, rgba(27,40,56,0.55) 40%, rgba(27,40,56,0.15) 100%);
    }
    .steam-detail-hero-inner {
      position: absolute;
      left: 24px;
      right: 24px;
      bottom: 20px;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .steam-detail-title {
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      line-height: 1.15;
      word-break: break-word;
    }
    .steam-detail-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .steam-play-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: #2EBA42;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 12px 28px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #3d5a0a;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .steam-play-btn:hover {
      background: #3ccb54;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .steam-play-btn:active {
      transform: translateY(1px);
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .steam-play-btn .play-icon {
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .steam-detail-stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #8f98a0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    }
    .steam-detail-stats strong {
      display: block;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: none;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .steam-detail-body {
      padding: 16px 24px 28px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .steam-detail-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    .steam-detail-main h4 {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .steam-detail-card {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .steam-detail-card p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: #acb2b8;
    }
    .steam-detail-back {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      left: 12px;
      z-index: 2;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .steam-detail-back:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); }
    .steam-detail-side .ach-bar {
      height: 6px;
      background: #0e1621;
      border-radius: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 8px 0 12px;
    }
    .steam-detail-side .ach-bar span {
      display: block;
      height: 100%;
      background: #66c0f4;
      width: 8%;
    }
    .lib-game-title, .game-tile .meta .title {
      white-space: normal;
      overflow: visible;
      text-overflow: unset;
      word-break: break-word;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .game-tile .meta .title {
      font-size: 11px;
      max-height: 2.6em;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    }
    .lib-game .lib-game-title {
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .steam-play-view {
      display: none;
      flex: 1;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .steam-library.active.has-playing .lib-sidebar,
    .steam-library.active.has-playing #steam-lib-main {
      display: none;
    }


    .steam-content { position: relative; }
    .steam-play-view {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 28px;
      z-index: 50;
      background: #0e1621;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .steam-play-view.active {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    .steam-play-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      background: #171a21;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .steam-play-bar button {
      background: #2a475e;
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif;
    }
    .steam-play-bar button:hover { background: #66c0f4; color: #1b2838; }
    .steam-play-bar strong {
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 14px;
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #steam-play-frame {
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
      border: none;
      background: #000;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .steam-play-error {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 40px 0 0 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
      color: #c7d5e0;
      background: #0e1621;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .steam-play-error button {
      background: #66c0f4;
      color: #1b2838;
      border: none;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .steam-footer-bar {
      height: 28px;
      background: #171a21;
      border-top: 1px solid #000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #8f98a0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .steam-footer-bar span { cursor: pointer; }
    .steam-footer-bar span:hover { color: #c7d5e0; }
    .steam-footer-bar .right { margin-left: auto; }

    .terminal_content {
      width: 100%; height: calc(100% - 38px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 12px 16px;
      background: rgba(5,5,99,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      color: #ebebeb; font-size: 16px; font-family: "Roboto Mono", monospace;
    }
    .color_green { color: #4ade80; }
    .color_blue { color: #60a5fa; }

    /* Calculator */
    .calculator {
      display: none; width: 280px; height: 420px; background: rgba(30,30,30,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-white-200);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }
    .calculator__top { height: 30%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .calculator__top--taskabr {
      height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .calculator__top--taskabr button {
      width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .calculator__top--taskabr button:nth-child(1) { background: #ff6059; }
    .calculator__top--taskabr button:nth-child(2) { background: #ffbd2e; }
    .calculator__top--taskabr button:nth-child(3) { background: #28c941; }
    .calculator__top--output {
      flex: 1; color: white; font-size: 2.2rem; text-align: right;
      background: transparent; padding: 0 16px; font-family: "Lexend";
    }
    .input {
      height: 70%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(5, 1fr);
    }
    .input .button {
      font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .operator { background: #fd9e2a; color: white; }
    .number { background: #d6d6d6; color: #111; }
    .operator-2 { background: #ccc9c9; color: #111; }
    .large { grid-column: span 2; }
    .r-radius { border-bottom-right-radius: 14px; }

    /* Launchpad */
    .launchpad {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 15;
      backdrop-filter: blur(30px); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }
    .searchbox {
      height: 100px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
    }
    .searchbox .searchContainer {
      height: 32px; width: 240px; display: flex; align-items: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 8px; gap: 6px;
    }
    .searchbox input {
      flex: 1; background: transparent; color: white; font-size: 15px; text-align: center;
    }
    .Apps-container {
      width: 90%; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 30px 20px;
    }
    .launchpad .child-launchpad {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .launchpad .child-launchpad img {
      width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 18px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
    }
    .launchpad .child-launchpad strong {
      color: white; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; text-align: center;
    }

    /* Spotlight */
    .spotlight_serach {
      width: 420px; height: 48px; display: none; align-items: center;
      position: absolute; top: 28%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-white-100); border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(40,40,40,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); z-index: 20;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); padding: 0 12px; gap: 10px;
    }
    .spotlight_serach input {
      flex: 1; background: transparent; color: white; font-size: 17px;
    }

    /* Context menu */
    .context-menu {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); z-index: 100;
      min-width: 220px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .context-menu ul li button {
      color: white; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-size: 14px; padding: 6px 12px;
      cursor: pointer; font-family: "Lexend";
    }
    .context-menu ul li button:hover { background: var(--color-blue-800); }

    /* Widgets */
    .widgets-panel {
      position: fixed; top: 42px; right: 12px; transform: translateX(120%);
      transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-white-200); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; z-index: 30;
    }
    .widgets-panel.open { transform: translateX(0); }
    .widgets-panel__calendar { padding: 18px; min-width: 170px; color: white; }
    .widgets-panel__calendar h2 { font-size: 42px; font-weight: 300; }
    .widgets-panel__calendar h4 { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.8; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  
    /* ===== Real Steam-like polish ===== */
    .steam {
      background: #1b2838 !important;
      border: 1px solid #000;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #3d4450, 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3d4450 0%, #23262e 100%) !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
      height: 28px;
    }
    .steam-nav {
      background: #171a21 !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
    }
    .steam-nav button, .steam-tab {
      color: #dcdedf !important;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }
    .steam-tab.active, .steam-nav button.active {
      color: #fff !important;
      box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #66c0f4;
    }
    .lib-sidebar {
      background: #171a21 !important;
      border-right: 1px solid #000;
      width: 260px !important;
      min-width: 220px;
    }
    .lib-sidebar-header {
      color: #8f98a0 !important;
      font-size: 11px !important;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 12px 14px 6px !important;
    }
    .lib-search input {
      background: #316282 !important;
      border: 1px solid #000 !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      border-radius: 2px !important;
      height: 28px;
    }
    .lib-search input::placeholder { color: #8f98a0; }
    .lib-game {
      padding: 4px 12px !important;
      font-size: 13px !important;
      color: #c7d5e0 !important;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
    }
    .lib-game:hover {
      background: rgba(102,192,244,0.12) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
    }
    .lib-game.active {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(102,192,244,0.25), rgba(102,192,244,0.08)) !important;
      color: #fff !important;

    }
    .lib-game .icon-sm {
      width: 28px !important;
      height: 28px !important;

    }
    .lib-main {

    }
    .lib-section h3 {

      color: #fff !important;
    }
    .game-tile {
      flex: 0 0 184px !important;
      background: #16202d !important;
      border-radius: 3px !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    }
    .game-tile:hover {

    }
    .game-tile .cover {

    }
    .game-tile .meta {

    }
    .game-tile .meta .title {
      font-size: 12px !important;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #c7d5e0 !important;
      white-space: normal !important;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      line-height: 1.3;
      max-height: 2.6em;
    }
    #steam-all-tiles {

    }
    #steam-all-tiles .game-tile {

    }
    .steam-detail-view {
      background: #1b2838 !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-hero {
      height: 320px !important;
      background-color: #0e1621;
    }
    .steam-detail-title {
      font-size: 36px !important;
      font-weight: 700 !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .steam-play-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a4d007 0%, #75b022 90%) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      font-size: 15px !important;

      border-radius: 2px !important;

      box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #5a7a0e, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2) !important;

    }
    .steam-play-btn:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #b6e00f 0%, #85c028 90%) !important;

    }
    .steam-play-btn:active {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #75b022 0%, #5a8a14 90%) !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-stats {

    }
    .steam-detail-stats > div {
      font-size: 10px !important;
      color: #8f98a0 !important;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    }
    .steam-detail-stats strong {
      font-size: 13px !important;
      color: #fff !important;

    }

    .steam-detail-card {

      font-size: 11px !important;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    }
    .steam-detail-back {
      background: rgba(23,26,33,0.75) !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) !important;
      color: #c7d5e0 !important;

    }
    .steam-detail-back:hover {
      background: rgba(102,192,244,0.2) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
    }
    .steam-footer-bar {
      background: #171a21 !important;
      border-top: 1px solid #000;
      color: #8f98a0 !important;

    }
    .steam-play-bar {
      background: #171a21 !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #000;
    }
    .steam-play-bar button {
      background: #2a475e !important;
      color: #c7d5e0 !important;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .steam-play-bar button:hover {
      background: #66c0f4 !important;
      color: #1b2838 !important;
    }

  
    /* Desktop backgrounds */
    body {
      background-image: url("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/background/iridescence.jpg") !important;
      background-size: cover !important;
      background-position: center center !important;
      background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
      background-attachment: fixed !important;
    }
    #desktop-bg {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      background-size: cover !important;
      background-position: center !important;
      background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
      background-color: #0f172a;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: background-image 0.25s ease;
    }
    html, body {
      background-color: #0f172a !important;
    }
    .context-menu {
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 9999 !important;
    }
    .context-menu.is-open,
    .context-menu[style*="opacity: 1"],
    .context-menu[style*="opacity:1"] {
      pointer-events: auto !important;
    }

    .navbar, .dock, .window, .launchpad, .spotlight_serach, #spotlight,
    .settings-window, .safari, .steam, .terminal, .note, .calculator,
    .Vscode, .maps, #contextMenu, #loading {
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .navbar { z-index: 30; }
    .dock { z-index: 30; }
    #contextMenu { z-index: 100; }


  
    .spotlight_serach {
      width: 560px !important;
      height: auto !important;
      min-height: 48px;
      max-height: 420px;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column !important;
      align-items: stretch !important;
      position: absolute;
      top: 18% !important;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(30,30,30,0.82) !important;
      backdrop-filter: blur(28px);
      z-index: 200 !important;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      padding: 0 !important;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .spotlight_serach .spotlight-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .spotlight_serach input {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      color: white;
      font-size: 18px;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
    }
    .spotlight-results {
      max-height: 340px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 6px 0;
    }
    .spotlight-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: #eee;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .spotlight-item:hover, .spotlight-item.active {
      background: rgba(0,120,255,0.55);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .spotlight-item img {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      object-fit: contain;
      background: transparent;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .spotlight-item .meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .spotlight-item .meta .name {
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .spotlight-item .meta .kind {
      font-size: 11px;
      opacity: 0.65;
    }
    .spotlight-empty {
      padding: 16px;
      text-align: center;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

  
    /* Authentic Steam color palette */
    .steam {
      background: #1b2838 !important;
      color: #c7d5e0;
    }
    .steam .window__taskbar {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #171a21 0%, #1b2838 100%) !important;
    }
    .steam-nav, .lib-sidebar, .steam-footer-bar, .steam-play-bar {
      background: #171a21 !important;
    }
    .lib-main, .steam-detail-view, .steam-store .steam-body, .steam-content {
      background: #1b2838 !important;
    }
    .steam-tab.active {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #1a9fff !important;
    }
    .steam-nav button:hover, .steam-tab:hover {
      color: #fff !important;
    }
    .lib-game.active {
      background: #1a3c5a !important;
      border-left-color: #1a9fff !important;
    }
    .lib-game:hover {
      background: #213447 !important;
    }
    .steam-play-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #a4d007 5%, #536904 95%) !important;
      border-radius: 2px !important;
      text-transform: uppercase !important;
      font-family: "Motiva Sans", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif !important;
    }
    .steam-play-btn:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #b6d908 5%, #6a820a 95%) !important;
    }
    .game-tile {
      background: #16202d !important;
    }
    .game-tile:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #1a9fff !important;
    }
    .lib-search input {
      background: #316282 !important;
      color: #fff !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-hero::after {
      background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(27,40,56,0.98) 0%, rgba(27,40,56,0.7) 40%, rgba(27,40,56,0.15) 100%) !important;
    }

  
    .steam-library.active:not(.has-detail):not(.has-playing) .lib-sidebar,
    .steam-library.active:not(.has-detail):not(.has-playing) #steam-lib-main {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    .steam-library.active:not(.has-detail):not(.has-playing) #steam-lib-main {
      display: block !important;
    }
    .lib-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    /* Make sure detail/play fill the library area */
    .steam-library.active.has-detail .steam-detail-view.active {
      display: flex !important;
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .steam-library.active.has-playing #steam-play-view.active {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    /* play view must be visible sibling */
    #steam-play-view.active {
      display: flex !important;
    }

  
    .steam-library.active.has-playing {
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .steam-library #steam-play-view {
      display: none;
      flex: 1;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .steam-library #steam-play-view.active,
    .steam-library.active.has-playing #steam-play-view {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-back, #steam-play-back, #steam-detail-play {
      pointer-events: auto !important;
      z-index: 50 !important;
      position: relative;
    }
    .steam-detail-back {
      position: absolute !important;
      z-index: 50 !important;
    }

  
    /* Transparent Steam chrome */
    .steam .window__taskbar {
      background: rgba(23, 26, 33, 0.55) !important;
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.2);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.2);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06) !important;
    }
    .steam-nav {
      background: rgba(23, 26, 33, 0.45) !important;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05) !important;
    }
    .steam-nav button.active,
    .steam-tab.active {
      box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #1a9fff !important;
      background: transparent !important;
      color: #fff !important;
    }
    /* PLAY button — match real Steam screenshot green */
    .steam-play-btn {
      background: #2EBA42 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      border: none !important;
      border-radius: 2px !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-size: 15px !important;
      font-weight: 700 !important;
      padding: 11px 28px !important;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
      text-transform: uppercase !important;
    }
    .steam-play-btn:hover {
      background: #3ccb54 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      filter: none !important;
      transform: none !important;
    }
    .steam-play-btn:active {
      background: #28a53a !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      transform: none !important;
    }

  
    /* System Settings / Wallpaper picker */
    .settings-window {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: 10%;
      left: 18%;
      width: 720px;
      height: 520px;
      background: #2c2c2e;
      /* backdrop-filter removed for scroll performance */
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      z-index: 45;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-direction: column;
      color: #f5f5f7;
      font-family: "Inter", "Lexend", system-ui, sans-serif;
    }
    .settings-window.active, .settings-window.open {
      display: flex;
    }
    .settings-window .window__taskbar {
      background: transparent !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      height: 42px;
    }
    .settings-window .window__taskbar--content h2 {
      color: #f5f5f7 !important;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .settings-body {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
    }
    .settings-sidebar {
      width: 180px;
      padding: 12px 10px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }
    .settings-sidebar button {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: transparent;
      color: #eee;
      font-size: 13px;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .settings-sidebar button.active,
    .settings-sidebar button:hover {
      background: rgba(0,122,255,0.85);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .settings-content {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      overscroll-behavior: contain;
      contain: content;
    }
    .settings-content h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .settings-content p.sub {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.7;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .wallpaper-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      /* Isolate paint so scrolling the parent stays cheap */
      contain: layout style;
    }
    .wallpaper-card {
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      background: #1c1c1e;
      /* No transform/transition on hover — those cause scroll jank */
      contain: layout paint style;
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain-intrinsic-size: 120px 100px;
    }
    .wallpaper-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28);
    }
    .wallpaper-card.selected {
      border-color: #0a84ff;
    }
    .wallpaper-card .thumb {
      width: 100%;
      height: 72px;
      display: block;
      background-color: #2a2a2c;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      /* Avoid continuous decoding cost while scrolling */
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .wallpaper-card .label {
      padding: 6px 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #f0f0f0;
      line-height: 1.25;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .wallpaper-card .label span {
      display: block;
      font-size: 10px;
      opacity: 0.5;
      font-weight: 400;
      margin-top: 1px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

  
    .settings-window .window__taskbar--actions button {
      width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
      border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
    }
    .settings-window .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(1) { background: #ff5f56; }
    .settings-window .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(2) { background: #ffbd2e; }
    .settings-window .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(3) { background: #27c93f; }

  
    .steam-play-btn {
      background: #2EBA42 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
    }
    .steam-play-btn:hover {
      background: #3ccb54 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
    }
    .steam-play-btn:active {
      background: #28a53a !important;
    }
  
    .steam-detail-hero::after {
      pointer-events: none !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-hero-inner {
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .steam-detail-hero-inner .steam-play-btn,
    .steam-detail-hero-inner .steam-detail-stats,
    .steam-detail-back,
    #steam-detail-back,
    #steam-play-back,
    #steam-detail-play {
      pointer-events: auto !important;
      cursor: pointer !important;
      z-index: 100 !important;
    }
    .steam-detail-back, #steam-detail-back {
      position: absolute !important;
      top: 14px !important;
      left: 14px !important;
      z-index: 100 !important;
      background: rgba(23,26,33,0.85) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15) !important;
      padding: 8px 14px !important;
      border-radius: 3px !important;
      font-size: 13px !important;
      font-weight: 600 !important;
    }
    #steam-play-back {
      pointer-events: auto !important;
      z-index: 100 !important;
      cursor: pointer !important;
      position: relative !important;
    }
    /* Keep library visible when not in detail/play */
    .steam-library.active:not(.has-detail):not(.has-playing) .lib-sidebar {
      display: flex !important;
      visibility: visible !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
    }
    .steam-library.active:not(.has-detail):not(.has-playing) #steam-lib-main {
      display: block !important;
      visibility: visible !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
    }

  
    /* Safari browser window */
    .safari {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: 8%;
      left: 12%;
      width: 900px;
      height: 580px;
      background: #1c1c1e;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      z-index: 40;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #f5f5f7;
    }
    .safari.active, .safari[style*="flex"], .safari[style*="block"] {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    .safari .window__taskbar {
      background: rgba(50,50,52,0.95) !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      height: 40px;
    }
    .safari .window__taskbar--content h2 {
      color: #f5f5f7 !important;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .safari .window__taskbar--actions button {
      width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
    }
    .safari .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(1) { background: #ff5f56; }
    .safari .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(2) { background: #ffbd2e; }
    .safari .window__taskbar--actions button:nth-child(3) { background: #27c93f; }
    .safari-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      background: #2c2c2e;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .safari-toolbar .nav-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .safari-toolbar .nav-btns button {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      color: #eee;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .safari-toolbar .nav-btns button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); }
    .safari-url {
      flex: 1;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: none;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      color: #f5f5f7;
      padding: 0 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
    }
    .safari-url:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(10,132,255,0.5); }
    .safari-go {
      height: 30px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: none;

      color: #fff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;

    }
    .safari-go:hover { background: #0071e3; }
    #safari-frame {
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
      border: none;
      background: #fff;
      min-height: 0;
    }

  
    .settings-window {
      z-index: 80 !important;
    }
    .settings-window.active,
    .settings-window.open,
    .settings-window[style*="flex"] {
      display: flex !important;
      visibility: visible !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      pointer-events: auto !important;
    }
    .safari.active, .safari[style*="flex"] {
      z-index: 75 !important;
      display: flex !important;
    }

  
    .Vscode {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      width: 960px;
      height: 640px;
      max-width: 96vw;
      max-height: 90vh;
      background: #1e1e1e;
      color: #d4d4d4;
      flex-direction: column;
      z-index: 50;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .Vscode[style*="block"], .Vscode[style*="flex"], .Vscode.active {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    .Vscode .window__taskbar {
      background: #3c3c3c !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .Vscode .window__taskbar--content h2 {
      color: #ccc !important;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .vscode-body {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      background: #1e1e1e;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .vscode-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: #252526;
      border-right: 1px solid #1e1e1e;
    }
    .vscode-activity {
      width: 48px;
      background: #333333;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 8px;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .vscode-act {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      background: transparent; border: none;
      color: #858585; font-size: 18px;
      cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .vscode-act:hover { color: #ccc; }
    .vscode-act.active {
      color: #fff;
      border-left: 2px solid #007acc;
      border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
    }
    .vscode-sidepanel {
      width: 220px;
      background: #252526;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .vscode-side-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: #bbbbbb;
      padding: 12px 16px 8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .vscode-filetree { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 0 8px; font-size: 13px; }
    .vscode-folder .vf-label {
      display: block; padding: 4px 12px; color: #cccccc; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
    }
    .vscode-folder .vf-label:hover { background: #2a2d2e; }
    .vscode-file {
      padding: 4px 12px 4px 28px; color: #cccccc; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .vscode-file:hover { background: #2a2d2e; }
    .vscode-file.active { background: #37373d; color: #fff; }
    .vscode-main {
      flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0;
      background: #1e1e1e;
    }
    .vscode-tabs {
      display: flex; background: #252526; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e1e1e;
      flex-shrink: 0; overflow-x: auto; height: 35px; align-items: stretch;
    }
    .vscode-tab {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 14px; font-size: 13px; color: #969696;
      background: #2d2d2d; border-right: 1px solid #1e1e1e;
      cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .vscode-tab.active { background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; }
    .vscode-tab .tab-x { opacity: 0.5; font-size: 14px; }
    .vscode-tab .tab-x:hover { opacity: 1; color: #fff; }
    .vscode-editor-wrap {
      flex: 1; position: relative; min-height: 0;
    }
    #monaco-editor { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
    .vscode-statusbar {
      height: 22px; background: #007acc; color: #fff;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
      padding: 0 12px; font-size: 12px; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .vscode-loading {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: #1e1e1e;
      color: #888;
      font-size: 14px;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .vscode-loading.hidden { display: none; }

  
    /* Faster image / tile rendering */
    .game-tile, .lib-game, .featured-card, .wallpaper-card {
      content-visibility: auto;
      contain-intrinsic-size: 160px 120px;
    }
    .game-tile .cover, .lib-game .icon-sm img, .featured-card .cover, .wallpaper-card .thumb {
      content-visibility: auto;
      decoding: async;
    }

  
    /* Maximize buttons — reliable hit target */
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full,
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full-note,
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full-Vscode,
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full-map,
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full-settings,
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full-safari,
    .window__taskbar--actions button.full-steam,
    button.full, button.full-note, button.full-Vscode, button.full-map,
    button.full-settings, button.full-safari, button.full-steam {
      cursor: pointer !important;
      pointer-events: auto !important;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 5;
    }

  </style>
</head>
