              <div class="steam-detail-card">
                <h4>Notes</h4>
                <p style="font-size:12px;color:#8f98a0;">No notes yet</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- GAME PLAY OVERLAY -->
        <div class="steam-play-view" id="steam-play-view">
          <div class="steam-play-bar">
            <button type="button" id="steam-play-back" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();if(window.backToSteamLibrary)window.backToSteamLibrary();return false;">← Library</button>
            <strong id="steam-play-title"></strong>
            <button type="button" id="steam-play-newtab" title="Open in new tab">↗</button>
          </div>
          <iframe id="steam-play-frame" src="about:blank" allow="fullscreen; autoplay; gamepad; keyboard-map; clipboard-write" allowfullscreen></iframe>
          <div id="steam-play-error" class="steam-play-error" style="display:none;">
            <p>This game could not be embedded.</p>
            <button type="button" id="steam-play-open-external">Open in new tab</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="steam-footer-bar">
          <span>+ Add a Game</span>
          <span>Manage Downloads</span>
          <span class="right">Friends & Chat</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    
    <!-- SYSTEM SETTINGS -->
    <div class="settings-window window" id="settings-window">
      <div class="window__taskbar">
        <div class="window__taskbar--actions">
          <button type="button" class="close-settings" title="Close"></button>
          <button type="button" class="backfull-settings" title="Minimize"></button>
          <button type="button" class="full-settings" title="Maximize"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="window__taskbar--content"><h2>System Settings</h2></div>
      </div>
      <div class="settings-body">
        <div class="settings-sidebar">
          <button type="button" class="settings-nav active" data-panel="wallpaper">Wallpaper</button>
          <button type="button" class="settings-nav" data-panel="general">General</button>
          <button type="button" class="settings-nav" data-panel="about">About</button>
        </div>
        <div class="settings-content">
          <div id="settings-panel-wallpaper">
            <h3>Wallpaper</h3>
            <p class="sub">Choose a desktop background. Your choice is saved and will not change on its own.</p>
            <div class="wallpaper-grid" id="wallpaper-grid"></div>
          </div>
          <div id="settings-panel-general" style="display:none">
            <h3>General</h3>
            <p class="sub">Appearance and desktop options.</p>
            <p style="font-size:13px;opacity:0.8;line-height:1.5">Wallpaper is managed under the Wallpaper tab. Right‑click the desktop for quick access as well.</p>
          </div>
          <div id="settings-panel-about" style="display:none">
            <h3>About This Mac</h3>
            <p class="sub">macOS web clone</p>
            <p style="font-size:13px;opacity:0.8;line-height:1.6">A browser-based desktop experience with Dock, Launchpad, Spotlight, and Steam.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    
    <!-- SAFARI -->
    <div class="safari window" id="safari-window">
      <div class="window__taskbar">
        <div class="window__taskbar--actions">
          <button type="button" class="close-safari" title="Close"></button>
          <button type="button" class="min-safari" title="Minimize"></button>
          <button type="button" class="full-safari" title="Maximize"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="window__taskbar--content"><h2>Safari</h2></div>
      </div>
      <div class="safari-toolbar">
        <div class="nav-btns">
          <button type="button" id="safari-back" title="Back">←</button>
          <button type="button" id="safari-forward" title="Forward">→</button>
          <button type="button" id="safari-reload" title="Reload">↻</button>
        </div>
        <input type="text" class="safari-url" id="safari-url" value="https://www.apple.com" spellcheck="false">
        <button type="button" class="safari-go" id="safari-go">Go</button>
      </div>
      <iframe id="safari-frame" src="https://www.apple.com" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe>
    </div>

    <div class="calculator">
      <div class="calculator__top">
        <div class="calculator__top--taskabr">
          <button class="close-cal"></button>
          <button></button>
          <button></button>
        </div>
        <input class="calculator__top--output display" type="text" value="0">
      </div>
      <div class="input">
        <button value="C" class="button operator-2">C</button>
        <button value="+/-" class="button operator-2">+/-</button>
        <button value="%" class="button operator-2">%</button>
        <button value="/" class="button operator">÷</button>
        <button value="7" class="button number">7</button>
        <button value="8" class="button number">8</button>
        <button value="9" class="button number">9</button>
        <button value="*" class="button operator">×</button>
        <button value="4" class="button number">4</button>
        <button value="5" class="button number">5</button>
        <button value="6" class="button number">6</button>
        <button value="-" class="button operator">−</button>
        <button value="1" class="button number">1</button>
        <button value="2" class="button number">2</button>
        <button value="3" class="button number">3</button>
        <button value="+" class="button operator">+</button>
        <button value="0" class="button number large">0</button>
        <button value="." class="button number">.</button>
        <button value="=" class="button operator r-radius">=</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section class="widgets-panel">
    <div class="widgets-panel__calendar">
      <h4 id="day-name">Tuesday</h4>
      <h2 id="day-num">19</h2>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="spotlight_serach" id="spotlight">
    <div class="spotlight-row">
      <svg width="18" height="18" fill="white"><path d="M10 18c1.846 0 3.543-.635 4.897-1.688l4.396 4.396 1.414-1.414-4.396-4.396C17.365 13.543 18 11.846 18 10c0-4.411-3.589-8-8-8s-8 3.589-8 8 3.589 8 8 8zm0-14c3.309 0 6 2.691 6 6s-2.691 6-6 6-6-2.691-6-6 2.691-6 6-6z"/></svg>
      <input type="search" id="spotlight-input" placeholder="Spotlight Search" autocomplete="off">
    </div>
    <div class="spotlight-results" id="spotlight-results"></div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const calculator = document.querySelector(".calculator");
    const closecal = document.querySelector(".close-cal");
    const close = document.querySelector(".close");
    const closenote = document.querySelector(".close-note");
    const container = document.querySelector(".container__Window");
    const full = document.querySelector(".full");
    const fullnote = document.querySelector(".full-note");
    const launchpad = document.querySelector(".launchpad");
    const navbar = document.querySelector(".navbar");
    const note = document.querySelector(".note");
    const opencalculator = document.querySelector(".open-cal");
    const point_cal = document.querySelector("#point-cal");
    const openNote = document.querySelector(".openNote");
    const opening = document.querySelector(".opening");
    const point_terminal = document.querySelector("#point-terminal");
    const point_note = document.querySelector("#point-note");
    const terminal = document.querySelector(".terminal");
    const app_name_terminal = document.querySelector("#Terminal");
    const app_name_notes = document.querySelector("#Notes");
    const app_name_calculator = document.querySelector("#calculator");
    const clockElement = document.getElementById("clock");
    const clockWrapper = document.querySelector(".clock");
    const widgetsPanel = document.querySelector(".widgets-panel");
    const batteryButton = document.querySelector(".battery");
    const batteryText = document.querySelector(".battery__text");
    const batteryPopup = document.querySelector(".battery__popup");
    const batteryPopupText = document.querySelector(".battery__popup header span");
    const batteryProgress = document.querySelector(".battery__progress");
    const powerSource = document.querySelector(".power-source");
    const open_vscode = document.querySelector(".open_vscode");
    const Vscode_window = document.querySelector(".Vscode");
    const app_name_VScode = document.querySelector("#VScode");
    const close_Vscode = document.querySelector(".close-Vscode");
    const point_vscode = document.querySelector("#point-vscode");
    const open_map = document.querySelector(".open_map");
    const maps_window = document.querySelector(".maps");
    const point_map = document.querySelector("#point-maps");
    const app_name_maps = document.querySelector("#map");
    const close_map = document.querySelector(".close-map");
    const open_spotlight = document.querySelector(".open_Search");
    const spotlight_serach = document.querySelector(".spotlight_serach");
    const opencalculator_lunchpad = document.querySelector(".open-cal-lunching");
    const open_steam = document.querySelector(".open_steam");
    const steam_window = document.querySelector(".steam");
    const point_steam = document.querySelector("#point-steam");
    const app_name_steam = document.querySelector("#Steam");
    const close_steam = document.querySelector(".close-steam");
    const full_steam = document.querySelector(".full-steam");
    const min_steam = document.querySelector(".backfull-steam");

    function handleopen_spotlight() {
      const el = document.getElementById("spotlight") || spotlight_serach;
      if (!el) return;
      const open = el.style.display === "flex";
      el.style.display = open ? "none" : "flex";
      if (!open) {
        const inp = document.getElementById("spotlight-input") || el.querySelector("input");
        if (inp) {
          inp.value = "";
          setTimeout(() => inp.focus(), 30);
        }
        renderSpotlightResults("");
      }
    }

    function renderSpotlightResults(query) {
      const box = document.getElementById("spotlight-results");
      if (!box) return;
      const q = (query || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      const apps = [
        { name: "Terminal", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/terminal.png", action: () => { if (terminal) open_window(terminal, point_terminal, app_name_terminal); } },
        { name: "Notes", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/notes.png", action: () => { if (note) open_window(note, point_note, app_name_notes); } },
        { name: "Calculator", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/calculator.png", action: () => { if (calculator) open_window(calculator, point_cal, app_name_calculator); } },
        { name: "VS Code", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/vscode.svg", action: () => { if (typeof openVSCode === "function") openVSCode(); else if (Vscode_window) open_window(Vscode_window, point_vscode, app_name_VScode); } },
        { name: "Maps", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/maps.png", action: () => { if (maps_window) open_window(maps_window, point_map, app_name_maps); } },
        { name: "Steam", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/steam3.png", action: () => { if (steam_window) open_window(steam_window, point_steam, app_name_steam); } },
        { name: "Safari", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/Launchpad/safari.png", action: () => { if (typeof openSafari === "function") openSafari(); } },
        { name: "System Settings", kind: "System", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/preferences.png", action: () => { if (typeof openSettings === "function") openSettings(); } },
        { name: "Launchpad", kind: "System", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/launchpad.png", action: () => { if (typeof handleOpenLaunching === "function") handleOpenLaunching(); } },
        { name: "Finder", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/finder.png", action: () => {} },
        { name: "App Store", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/appstore.png", action: () => {} },
        { name: "Messages", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/message.png", action: () => {} },
        { name: "Music", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/music.png", action: () => {} },
        { name: "Mail", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/mail.png", action: () => {} },
        { name: "Photos", kind: "Application", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/chachereben29-stack/Mac-OS-clone/icon/dock/photos.png", action: () => {} }
      ];
      // Apps only — games are NOT searchable in Spotlight
      let results = apps.filter(a => !q || a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      if (!results.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<div class="spotlight-empty">No results</div>';
        return;
      }
      box.innerHTML = results.map((r, i) => {
        const img = '<img src="' + String(r.icon || "").replace(/"/g, """) + '" alt="" onerror="this.src=\'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=' + encodeURIComponent((r.name||"?")[0]) + '&background=555&color=fff&size=56\'">';
        return '<div class="spotlight-item" data-i="' + i + '">' + img +
          '<div class="meta"><span class="name">' + String(r.name||"").replace(/</g,"<") +
          '</span><span class="kind">' + (r.kind||"") + '</span></div></div>';
      }).join("");
      box.querySelectorAll(".spotlight-item").forEach((el, i) => {
        el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const r = results[i];
          if (r && r.action) r.action();
          const sp = document.getElementById("spotlight") || (typeof spotlight_serach !== "undefined" ? spotlight_serach : null);
          if (sp) sp.style.display = "none";
        });
      });
    }

    // Spotlight input + keyboard
    (function initSpotlight() {
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        // Cmd/Ctrl + Space
        if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.code === "Space") {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleopen_spotlight();
        }
        if (e.key === "Escape") {
          const sp = document.getElementById("spotlight") || spotlight_serach;
          if (sp && sp.style.display === "flex") sp.style.display = "none";
        }
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        const inp = document.getElementById("spotlight-input");
        if (inp) {
          inp.addEventListener("input", () => renderSpotlightResults(inp.value));
          inp.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") {
              const first = document.querySelector(".spotlight-item");
              if (first) first.click();
            }
          });
        }
      }, 200);
    })();

    // ---- Maximize / restore (green traffic-light) ----
    const _winGeom = new WeakMap();

    function _saveWinGeom(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      // Always refresh saved geometry from current inline + computed
      const cs = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      _winGeom.set(el, {
        cssText: el.style.cssText,
        width: el.style.width || (rect.width + "px"),
        height: el.style.height || (rect.height + "px"),
        top: el.style.top || (rect.top + "px"),
        left: el.style.left || (rect.left + "px"),
        display: el.style.display || cs.display,
        position: el.style.position || cs.position
      });
    }

    function _applyMaximized(el) {
      el.classList.add("is-maximized");
      el.classList.remove("maximized");
      // Force with inline !important so no other rule can win
      el.style.setProperty("position", "fixed", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("top", "28px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("left", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("right", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("bottom", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("width", "100vw", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("height", "calc(100vh - 28px)", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("max-width", "none", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("min-width", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("max-height", "none", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("min-height", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("border-radius", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("margin", "0px", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("transform", "none", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("z-index", "60", "important");
      // Keep it visible
      if (el.classList.contains("steam") || el.classList.contains("Vscode") ||
          el.classList.contains("safari") || el.classList.contains("settings-window")) {
        el.style.setProperty("display", "flex", "important");
      } else {
        el.style.setProperty("display", "block", "important");
      }
      try {
        if (el.parentElement) el.parentElement.appendChild(el);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function _restoreWinGeom(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      const g = _winGeom.get(el);
      el.classList.remove("is-maximized", "maximized");
      // Clear forced properties first
      ["position","top","left","right","bottom","width","height","max-width","min-width",
       "max-height","min-height","border-radius","margin","transform","z-index","display"]
        .forEach(p => el.style.removeProperty(p));
      if (g) {
        if (g.cssText) el.style.cssText = g.cssText;
        else {
          if (g.width) el.style.width = g.width;
          if (g.height) el.style.height = g.height;
          if (g.top) el.style.top = g.top;
          if (g.left) el.style.left = g.left;
          if (g.position) el.style.position = g.position;
          if (g.display) el.style.display = g.display;
        }
        _winGeom.delete(el);
      }
      // Ensure still visible after restore
      if (!el.style.display || el.style.display === "none") {
        if (el.classList.contains("steam") || el.classList.contains("Vscode") ||
            el.classList.contains("safari") || el.classList.contains("settings-window")) {
          el.style.display = "flex";
        } else {
          el.style.display = "block";
        }
      }
    }

    function toggleMaximize(el) {
      if (!el) return false;
      const isMax = el.classList.contains("is-maximized") || el.classList.contains("maximized");
      if (isMax) _restoreWinGeom(el);
      else {
        _saveWinGeom(el);
        _applyMaximized(el);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        try {
          if (typeof _monacoEditor !== "undefined" && _monacoEditor &&
              (el.classList.contains("Vscode") || el.id === "vscode-window")) {
            _monacoEditor.layout();
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        try { window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize")); } catch (e) {}
      });
      return true;
    }
    window.toggleMaximize = toggleMaximize;

    function handleFullScreen(el) {
      toggleMaximize(el);
    }

    function close_window(win, point, appName) {
      if (!win) return;
      win.style.display = "none";
      win.classList.remove("maximized", "minimized", "is-maximized");
      try { _winGeom.delete(win); } catch (e) {}
      if (point) point.style.display = "none";
      if (appName) appName.style.display = "none";
    }
    function open_window(win, point, appName) {
      navbar.style.display = "flex";
      win.classList.remove("minimized");
      win.style.display = win.classList.contains("steam") ? "flex" : "block";
      container.style.display = "flex";
      launchpad.style.display = "none";
      if (appName) appName.style.display = "block";
      if (point) point.style.display = "block";
    }

    function minimize_steam() {
      if (!steam_window) return;
      steam_window.classList.add("minimized");
      steam_window.style.display = "none";
      // keep dock indicator visible so user can restore
      if (point_steam) point_steam.style.display = "block";
      if (app_name_steam) app_name_steam.style.display = "none";
    }

    function toggle_maximize_steam() {
      if (!steam_window) return;
      toggleMaximize(steam_window);
    }

    function handleOpenLaunching() {
      if (launchpad.style.display === "block") {
        launchpad.style.display = "none";
        navbar.style.display = "flex";
      } else {
        launchpad.style.display = "block";
        navbar.style.display = "none";
        container.style.display = "none";
      }
    }

    function handleOpenCal_lunchpad() {
      calculator.style.display = "block";
      container.style.display = "flex";
      navbar.style.display = "flex";
      launchpad.style.display = "none";
      if (point_cal) point_cal.style.display = "block";
    }

    if (close) close.addEventListener("click", () => close_window(terminal, point_terminal, app_name_terminal));
    if (closenote) closenote.addEventListener("click", () => close_window(note, point_note, app_name_notes));
    if (closecal) closecal.addEventListener("click", () => close_window(calculator, point_cal, app_name_calculator));
    if (close_Vscode) close_Vscode.addEventListener("click", () => close_window(Vscode_window, point_vscode, app_name_VScode));
    if (close_map) close_map.addEventListener("click", () => close_window(maps_window, point_map, app_name_maps));
    // Prevent jQuery UI drag from eating window control clicks
    [close_steam, min_steam, full_steam].forEach(btn => {
      if (!btn) return;
      btn.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
      btn.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    });
    if (close_steam) close_steam.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      close_window(steam_window, point_steam, app_name_steam);
    });
    if (min_steam) min_steam.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      minimize_steam();
    });
    // full_steam maximize handled by capture-phase delegate

    if (opening) opening.addEventListener("click", () => open_window(terminal, point_terminal, app_name_terminal));
    if (openNote) openNote.addEventListener("click", () => open_window(note, point_note, app_name_notes));
    if (opencalculator) opencalculator.addEventListener("click", () => open_window(calculator, point_cal, app_name_calculator));
    if (open_vscode) open_vscode.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (typeof openVSCode === "function") openVSCode(); else open_window(Vscode_window, point_vscode, app_name_VScode); });
    if (open_map) open_map.addEventListener("click", () => open_window(maps_window, point_map, app_name_maps));
    if (open_steam) open_steam.addEventListener("click", () => {
      open_window(steam_window, point_steam, app_name_steam);
      steam_window.style.display = "flex";
      steam_window.classList.remove("minimized");
    });
    if (opencalculator_lunchpad) opencalculator_lunchpad.addEventListener("click", handleOpenCal_lunchpad);
    if (open_spotlight) open_spotlight.addEventListener("click", handleopen_spotlight);

    if (full) full.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); handleFullScreen(terminal); });
    if (fullnote) fullnote.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); handleFullScreen(note); });

    // Capture-phase delegation — works even if other handlers stop propagation
    const MAXIMIZE_BTN_SEL = ".full, .full-note, .full-Vscode, .full-map, .full-settings, .full-safari, .full-steam";
    function findWindowFrom(el) {
      if (!el) return null;
      return el.closest(".window, .settings-window, .safari, .steam, .Vscode, .calculator, #vscode-window, #settings-window, #safari-window");
    }
    document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      const btn = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(MAXIMIZE_BTN_SEL);
      if (!btn) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();

      const win = findWindowFrom(btn);
      if (win) toggleMaximize(win);
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", function(e) {
      const btn = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(MAXIMIZE_BTN_SEL);
      if (!btn) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.stopImmediatePropagation) e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);

    // Double-click title bar to maximize (macOS behavior)
    document.addEventListener("dblclick", function(e) {
      const bar = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".window__taskbar");
      if (!bar) return;
      if (e.target.closest("button, input, a")) return;
      const win = findWindowFrom(bar);
      if (win) toggleMaximize(win);
    }, true);

    function renderSteamLibrary(filter = "") {
      const list = document.getElementById("steam-lib-games");
      const tiles = document.getElementById("steam-all-tiles");
      const countEl = document.getElementById("steam-game-count");
      if (!list || !tiles || typeof STEAM_GAMES === "undefined") return;
      const q = (filter || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      const filtered = STEAM_GAMES.filter(g => !q || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = "(" + filtered.length + ")";
      // Sidebar list (capped for performance)
      const sideGames = q ? filtered.slice(0, 120) : filtered.slice(0, 80);
      list.innerHTML = sideGames.map((g, i) => {
        const initials = g.title.split(/\s+/).map(w => w[0]).join("").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        const idx = STEAM_GAMES.indexOf(g);
        const img = '<img src="' + g.image + '" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="28" height="28" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\';this.parentNode.textContent=\'' + initials + '\';">';
        return '<div class="lib-game" data-idx="' + idx + '"><div class="icon-sm">' + img + '</div><span class="lib-game-title">' + g.title.replace(/</g,"<") + '</span></div>';
      }).join("");
      // Tiles grid — fewer tiles for faster first paint
      const tileGames = filtered.slice(0, 48);
      tiles.innerHTML = tileGames.map(g => {
        const idx = STEAM_GAMES.indexOf(g);
        return '<div class="game-tile" data-idx="' + idx + '" title="' + g.title.replace(/"/g,""") + '">' +
          '<img class="cover" src="' + g.image + '" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="184" height="86" onerror="this.style.background=\'#0e1621\';this.removeAttribute(\'src\')">' +
          '<div class="meta"><div class="title">' + g.title.replace(/</g,"<") + '</div></div></div>';
      }).join("");
      // clicks via event delegation (see setTimeout below)
    }

    let _currentPlayUrl = "";
    let _currentGameIdx = -1;

    function showSteamDetail(idx) {
      const g = STEAM_GAMES[idx];
      if (!g) return;
      _currentGameIdx = idx;
      const detail = document.getElementById("steam-detail-view");
      const playView = document.getElementById("steam-play-view");
      const lib = document.getElementById("steam-library");
      const store = document.getElementById("steam-store");
      if (playView) {
        playView.classList.remove("active");
        playView.style.display = "none";
      }
      if (store) store.classList.remove("active");
      if (lib) {
        lib.classList.add("has-detail");
        lib.classList.remove("has-playing");
        lib.classList.add("active");
        lib.style.display = "none";
      }
      const hero = document.getElementById("steam-detail-hero");
      const titleEl = document.getElementById("steam-detail-title");
      const about = document.getElementById("steam-detail-about");
      if (hero) {
        const img = (g.image || "").replace(/'/g, "\\'");
        hero.style.backgroundImage = "linear-gradient(to right, rgba(27,40,56,0.95) 0%, rgba(27,40,56,0.5) 50%, rgba(27,40,56,0.15) 100%), url('" + img + "')";
        hero.style.backgroundSize = "cover";
        hero.style.backgroundPosition = "center top";
      }
      if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = g.title;
      if (about) about.textContent = g.title + " is in your library. Press the green PLAY button to launch it.";
      const lastEl = document.getElementById("steam-detail-last");
      const timeEl = document.getElementById("steam-detail-time");
      if (lastEl) lastEl.textContent = (idx % 5 === 0) ? "Never" : "Sep " + (1 + (idx % 14));
      if (timeEl) timeEl.textContent = ((idx % 20) + 1) + "." + (idx % 10) + " hours";
      document.querySelectorAll(".lib-game").forEach(el => {
        el.classList.toggle("active", el.dataset.idx === String(idx));
      });
      if (detail) {
        detail.classList.add("active");
        detail.style.display = "flex";
        detail.style.flex = "1";
        detail.style.minHeight = "0";
        detail.style.width = "100%";
      }
    }

    function hideSteamDetail() {
      const detail = document.getElementById("steam-detail-view");
      const playView = document.getElementById("steam-play-view");
      const frame = document.getElementById("steam-play-frame");
      const lib = document.getElementById("steam-library");
      if (detail) {
        detail.classList.remove("active");
        detail.style.display = "none";
      }
      if (playView) {
        playView.classList.remove("active");
        playView.style.display = "none";
      }
      if (frame) {
        try { frame.src = "about:blank"; frame.removeAttribute("srcdoc"); } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (lib) {
        lib.classList.remove("has-detail");
        lib.classList.remove("has-playing");
        lib.classList.add("active");
        lib.style.display = "flex";
      }
      document.querySelectorAll(".lib-game.active").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active"));
      _currentGameIdx = -1;
      _currentPlayUrl = "";
    }


    function playSteamGame(idx) {
      if (idx == null || idx === undefined) idx = _currentGameIdx;
      const g = STEAM_GAMES[idx];
      if (!g || !g.url) {
        console.warn("Steam: invalid game", idx);
        return;
      }
      _currentPlayUrl = g.url;
      _currentGameIdx = idx;
      const playView = document.getElementById("steam-play-view");
      const frame = document.getElementById("steam-play-frame");
      const title = document.getElementById("steam-play-title");
      const err = document.getElementById("steam-play-error");
      const detail = document.getElementById("steam-detail-view");
      const lib = document.getElementById("steam-library");
      if (detail) { detail.classList.remove("active"); detail.style.display = "none"; }
      if (lib) {
        lib.classList.add("has-playing");
        lib.classList.remove("has-detail");
        lib.classList.add("active");
        lib.style.display = "none";
      }
      if (title) title.textContent = g.title + " — Loading…";
      if (err) err.style.display = "none";
      if (playView) {
        playView.classList.add("active");
        playView.style.display = "flex";
      }
      if (!frame) return;

      // Clear previous
      frame.removeAttribute("srcdoc");
      frame.src = "about:blank";

      // Many CDNs serve HTML as text/plain which blocks iframe rendering.
      // Fetch the HTML (CORS is open) and inject via srcdoc instead.
      fetch(g.url, { mode: "cors" })
        .then(r => {
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
          return r.text();
        })
        .then(htmlText => {
          // Fix relative asset paths by injecting <base href="...">
          let base = g.url.replace(/\/[^\/]*$/, "/");
          // if url ends with .html directly under a folder, base is that folder
          if (!/<base\s/i.test(htmlText)) {
            if (/<head[^>]*>/i.test(htmlText)) {
              htmlText = htmlText.replace(/<head([^>]*)>/i, '<head$1><base href="' + base + '">');
            } else {
              htmlText = '<base href="' + base + '">' + htmlText;
            }
          }
          if (title) title.textContent = g.title;
          frame.srcdoc = htmlText;
        })
        .catch(errObj => {
          console.warn("Steam embed failed, trying direct src", errObj);
          // Fallback: try direct iframe src, then external tab
          frame.src = g.url;
          if (title) title.textContent = g.title;
          setTimeout(() => {
            // If still blank-ish, show error with open external option
            try {
              // cannot read cross-origin; just offer external
            } catch (e) {}
          }, 2000);
        });
    }

    function backToSteamLibrary() {
      try {
        const detail = document.getElementById("steam-detail-view");
        const playView = document.getElementById("steam-play-view");
        const frame = document.getElementById("steam-play-frame");
        const err = document.getElementById("steam-play-error");
        const lib = document.getElementById("steam-library");
        const store = document.getElementById("steam-store");
        if (frame) { try { frame.src = "about:blank"; frame.removeAttribute("srcdoc"); } catch (e) {} }
        if (err) err.style.display = "none";
        if (detail) { detail.classList.remove("active"); detail.style.display = "none"; }
        if (playView) { playView.classList.remove("active"); playView.style.display = "none"; }
        if (store) store.classList.remove("active");
        if (lib) {
          lib.classList.add("active");
          lib.classList.remove("has-playing");
          lib.classList.remove("has-detail");
          lib.style.display = "flex";
          lib.style.visibility = "visible";
          const side = lib.querySelector(".lib-sidebar");
          const main = document.getElementById("steam-lib-main");
          if (side) { side.style.display = "flex"; side.style.visibility = "visible"; }
          if (main) { main.style.display = "block"; main.style.visibility = "visible"; }
        }
        document.querySelectorAll(".lib-game.active").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active"));
        document.querySelectorAll(".steam-tab").forEach(t => {
          t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.tab === "library");
        });
        _currentGameIdx = -1;
        _currentPlayUrl = "";
        if (typeof renderSteamLibrary === "function") renderSteamLibrary();
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("backToSteamLibrary error", err);
      }
    }
    // Global so inline onclick works even if listeners fail

      const backBtn = document.getElementById("steam-play-back");

        backBtn.addEventListener("click", steamBackHandler, true);
        backBtn.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); }, true);

      const detailBack = document.getElementById("steam-detail-back");

          playSteamGame(_currentGameIdx);

        detailPlay.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); }, true);

            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();

          if (t && (t.id === "steam-detail-play" || t.closest("#steam-detail-play"))) {

    // Calculator
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".input button");
    const display = document.querySelector(".display");
    const operators = ["+", "-", "*", "/"];

    function lastNumber(value) {
      let temp = value;
      operators.forEach(op => temp = temp.split(op).join("|"));
      return temp.split("|").pop();
    }

    function calculate(value) {
      const latest = display.value.slice(-1);
      const isEmpty = display.value === "0";
      const isNum = "0123456789".includes(value);

      if (isEmpty && isNum) return display.value = value;
      if (value === "=") { try { display.value = eval(display.value); } catch(e) {} return; }
      if (value === ".") { if (!lastNumber(display.value).includes(".")) display.value += "."; return; }
      if (value === "C") return display.value = "0";
      if (value === "+/-") { display.value = String(-1 * parseFloat(display.value)); return; }
      if (operators.includes(value) || value === "%") {
        if (operators.includes(latest) || latest === "%") display.value = display.value.slice(0, -1) + value;
        else display.value += value;
        return;
      }
      display.value += value;
    }
    buttons.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", e => calculate(e.target.value)));

    function placeCaretAtEnd(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.focus();
      const range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(el);
      range.collapse(false);
      const sel = window.getSelection();
      sel.removeAllRanges();
      sel.addRange(range);
    }

    function init_terminal_line() {
      $(".cursor").off("keydown").on("keydown", function(e) {
        if (e.keyCode === 13) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const command = $(this).text().trim();
          if (!command) return;
          let output = `zsh: command not found: ${command}<br>`;
          if (command.startsWith("cd ")) { path = command.slice(3); output = ""; }
          else if (command === "ls") output = dirs.join("\t") + "<br>";
          else if (command === "pwd") output = path + "/<br>";
          else if (command.startsWith("mkdir ")) { dirs.push(command.slice(6)); output = ""; }
          else if (command === "clear") { $(".terminal_content").html(""); output = ""; }
          $(this).removeAttr("contenteditable").removeClass("cursor");
          $(".terminal_content").append(output).append(terminal_line_html.replace("~", path));
          placeCaretAtEnd(document.querySelector(".cursor"));
          init_terminal_line();
        }
      });
    }
    init_terminal_line();

    let _bgIndex = 0;
    // Image cache so wallpapers switch instantly after first load
    const _bgCache = Object.create(null);
    function preloadBackground(url) {
      if (!url || _bgCache[url]) return _bgCache[url];
      const img = new Image();
      img.decoding = "async";
      img.loading = "eager";
      img.src = url;
      _bgCache[url] = img;
      return img;
    }
    function applyBgCss(safe) {
      const cssUrl = 'url("' + safe.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '")';
      const el = document.getElementById("desktop-bg");
      if (el) {
        el.style.setProperty("background-image", cssUrl, "important");
        el.style.setProperty("background-size", "cover", "important");
        el.style.setProperty("background-position", "center", "important");
        el.style.setProperty("background-repeat", "no-repeat", "important");
      }
      document.body.style.setProperty("background-image", cssUrl, "important");
      document.body.style.setProperty("background-size", "cover", "important");
      document.body.style.setProperty("background-position", "center", "important");
      document.body.style.setProperty("background-repeat", "no-repeat", "important");
      document.body.style.setProperty("background-attachment", "fixed", "important");
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("background-image", cssUrl, "important");
      document.querySelectorAll(".wallpaper-card").forEach(c => {
        const u = c.getAttribute("data-url") || "";
        c.classList.toggle("selected", u === safe);
      });
    }
    function setDesktopBackground(url) {
      try {
        if (!url) return;
        const safe = String(url).trim();
        const img = preloadBackground(safe);
        const apply = () => {
          applyBgCss(safe);
          try { localStorage.setItem("macos_desktop_bg", safe); } catch (e) {}
        };
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
          apply();
        } else {
          // Apply immediately so UI feels responsive; image finishes loading in bg
          apply();
          img.addEventListener("load", apply, { once: true });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("setDesktopBackground failed", e);
      }
    }
    // Preload ALL wallpapers in the background (throttled) so switching is instant
    function preloadAllWallpapers() {
      // Only preload the current wallpaper — full list preload was lagging the site
      if (typeof DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS === "undefined") return;
      let url = null;
      try { url = localStorage.getItem("macos_desktop_bg"); } catch (e) {}
      if (!url && DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[0]) url = DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[0].url;
      if (url) preloadBackground(url);
    }
    preloadAllWallpapers();
window.setDesktopBackground = setDesktopBackground;
    window.setDesktopBackground = setDesktopBackground;
    window.cycleDesktopBackground = function() {
      if (typeof DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS === "undefined" || !DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS.length) return;
      if (typeof _bgIndex === "undefined") window._bgIndex = 0;
      window._bgIndex = ((window._bgIndex || 0) + 1) % DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS.length;
      _bgIndex = window._bgIndex;
      setDesktopBackground(DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[_bgIndex].url);
    };
    function cycleDesktopBackground() { window.cycleDesktopBackground(); }
    function cycleDesktopBackground() {
      if (typeof DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS === "undefined" || !DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS.length) return;
      _bgIndex = (_bgIndex + 1) % DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS.length;
      setDesktopBackground(DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[_bgIndex].url);
    }
    (function initBg() {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem("macos_desktop_bg");
        if (saved) {
          const idx = DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS.findIndex(b => b.url === saved);
          if (idx >= 0) _bgIndex = idx;
          setDesktopBackground(saved);
        } else {
          setDesktopBackground(DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[0].url);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        try { setDesktopBackground(DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[0].url); } catch (e2) {}
      }
    })();

    // ===== System Settings =====
    const settings_window = document.getElementById("settings-window");
    const close_settings = document.querySelector(".close-settings");
    const point_settings = document.getElementById("point-settings");

    let _settingsDragWired = false;
    function openSettings() {
      window.openSettings = openSettings;
      const win = document.getElementById("settings-window");
      if (!win) { console.warn("settings-window missing"); return; }
      try {
        if (typeof navbar !== "undefined" && navbar) navbar.style.display = "flex";
        if (typeof launchpad !== "undefined" && launchpad) launchpad.style.display = "none";
        if (typeof container !== "undefined" && container) container.style.display = "flex";
      } catch (e) {}
      win.classList.remove("minimized");
      win.classList.add("active", "open");
      win.style.display = "flex";
      win.style.visibility = "visible";
      win.style.opacity = "1";
      win.style.zIndex = "80";
      win.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
      const ps = document.getElementById("point-settings");
      if (ps) ps.style.display = "block";
      // Defer heavy wallpaper grid so the window appears instantly
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        if (typeof renderWallpaperGrid === "function") renderWallpaperGrid();
      });
      // Wire draggable only once
      if (!_settingsDragWired && window.jQuery) {
        _settingsDragWired = true;
        try {
          $(win).draggable({
            handle: ".window__taskbar",
            cancel: "button, input, .wallpaper-card, .settings-sidebar"
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    function closeSettings() {
      const win = document.getElementById("settings-window");
      if (!win) return;
      win.style.display = "none";
      win.classList.remove("active", "open");
      const ps = document.getElementById("point-settings");
      if (ps) ps.style.display = "none";
    }
    if (close_settings) close_settings.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeSettings(); });
    document.querySelectorAll(".open_settings, .open_settings_menu").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); openSettings(); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".settings-nav").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        document.querySelectorAll(".settings-nav").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
        btn.classList.add("active");
        const panel = btn.dataset.panel;
        ["wallpaper", "general", "about"].forEach(p => {
          const el = document.getElementById("settings-panel-" + p);
          if (el) el.style.display = p === panel ? "block" : "none";
        });
      });
    });
    let _wallpaperGridBuilt = false;
    let _wpIO = null;
    const _wpLoadQueue = [];
    let _wpActiveLoads = 0;
    const WP_MAX_CONCURRENT = 3;

    function _wpPumpQueue() {
      while (_wpActiveLoads < WP_MAX_CONCURRENT && _wpLoadQueue.length) {
        const job = _wpLoadQueue.shift();
        if (!job || !job.thumb || job.thumb.dataset.loaded === "1") continue;
        _wpActiveLoads++;
        const img = new Image();
        img.decoding = "async";
        // Hint smaller decode where supported (browser may ignore)
        try { img.sizes = "140px"; } catch (e) {}
        const done = () => {
          _wpActiveLoads = Math.max(0, _wpActiveLoads - 1);
          _wpPumpQueue();
        };
        img.onload = () => {
          // Use the already-decoded image as a CSS background only when ready
          try {
            job.thumb.style.backgroundImage = "url(\"" + job.url.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"') + "\")";
            job.thumb.dataset.loaded = "1";
          } catch (e) {}
          done();
        };
        img.onerror = done;
        img.src = job.url;
      }
    }

    function renderWallpaperGrid() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("wallpaper-grid");
      if (!grid || typeof DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS === "undefined") return;
      let current = null;
      try { current = localStorage.getItem("macos_desktop_bg"); } catch (e) {}
      if (!current && DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[0]) current = DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[0].url;

      if (_wallpaperGridBuilt && grid.childElementCount > 0) {
        grid.querySelectorAll(".wallpaper-card").forEach(c => {
          c.classList.toggle("selected", (c.getAttribute("data-url") || "") === current);
        });
        return;
      }

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      // Precomputed soft placeholder colors so the grid feels instant
      const placeholders = ["#3a3a3c","#2f3540","#3d2f2f","#2f3d34","#35304a","#40382f"];
      DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS.forEach((bg, i) => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "wallpaper-card" + (bg.url === current ? " selected" : "");
        card.setAttribute("data-url", bg.url);
        card.setAttribute("data-i", String(i));

        const thumb = document.createElement("div");
        thumb.className = "thumb";
        thumb.style.backgroundColor = placeholders[i % placeholders.length];

        const label = document.createElement("div");
        label.className = "label";
        const name = document.createTextNode(bg.name || "");
        const span = document.createElement("span");
        span.textContent = bg.version || "";
        label.appendChild(name);
        label.appendChild(span);

        card.appendChild(thumb);
        card.appendChild(label);
        frag.appendChild(card);
      });
      grid.textContent = "";
      grid.appendChild(frag);

      if (!grid._wpClickWired) {
        grid._wpClickWired = true;
        grid.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          const card = e.target.closest(".wallpaper-card");
          if (!card) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          const url = card.getAttribute("data-url");
          const i = parseInt(card.getAttribute("data-i"), 10);
          if (!isNaN(i)) _bgIndex = i;
          if (url && typeof setDesktopBackground === "function") setDesktopBackground(url);
          grid.querySelectorAll(".wallpaper-card.selected").forEach(c => c.classList.remove("selected"));
          card.classList.add("selected");
        });
      }

      // Observe visibility; enqueue loads (max 3 concurrent) so scrolling stays smooth
      if (_wpIO) { try { _wpIO.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} }
      const scrollRoot = grid.closest(".settings-content") || null;
      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
        _wpIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            const card = entry.target;
            const thumb = card.querySelector(".thumb");
            const url = card.getAttribute("data-url");
            if (!thumb || !url) return;
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              if (thumb.dataset.loaded === "1" || thumb.dataset.queued === "1") return;
              thumb.dataset.queued = "1";
              _wpLoadQueue.push({ thumb, url });
              _wpPumpQueue();
            }
          });
        }, { root: scrollRoot, rootMargin: "40px", threshold: 0.01 });
        grid.querySelectorAll(".wallpaper-card").forEach(c => _wpIO.observe(c));
      } else {
        // Fallback: load a few at a time after idle
        const cards = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll(".wallpaper-card"));
        let n = 0;
        const step = () => {
          if (n >= cards.length) return;
          const batch = cards.slice(n, n + 3);
          n += 3;
          batch.forEach(card => {
            const thumb = card.querySelector(".thumb");
            const url = card.getAttribute("data-url");
            if (thumb && url) _wpLoadQueue.push({ thumb, url });
          });
          _wpPumpQueue();
          setTimeout(step, 200);
        };
        setTimeout(step, 50);
      }

      _wallpaperGridBuilt = true;
    }

    // ===== Safari =====
    const safari_window = document.getElementById("safari-window");
    const open_safari = document.querySelector(".open_safari");
    const close_safari_btn = document.querySelector(".close-safari");
    const point_safari = document.getElementById("point-safari");

    function openSafari() {
      window.openSafari = openSafari;
      if (!safari_window) return;
      if (navbar) navbar.style.display = "flex";
      safari_window.style.display = "flex";
      safari_window.classList.add("active");
      if (point_safari) point_safari.style.display = "block";
    }
    function closeSafari() {
      if (!safari_window) return;
      safari_window.style.display = "none";
      safari_window.classList.remove("active");
      if (point_safari) point_safari.style.display = "none";
    }
    if (open_safari) open_safari.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); openSafari(); });
    if (close_safari_btn) close_safari_btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeSafari(); });
    const safariGo = document.getElementById("safari-go");
    const safariUrl = document.getElementById("safari-url");
    const safariFrame = document.getElementById("safari-frame");
    function navigateSafari() {
      if (!safariUrl || !safariFrame) return;
      let u = (safariUrl.value || "").trim();
      if (!u) return;
      if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)) u = "https://" + u;
      safariUrl.value = u;
      try { safariFrame.src = u; } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (safariGo) safariGo.addEventListener("click", navigateSafari);
    if (safariUrl) safariUrl.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") navigateSafari(); });
    const safariBackBtn = document.getElementById("safari-back");
    const safariFwd = document.getElementById("safari-forward");
    const safariReload = document.getElementById("safari-reload");
    if (safariBackBtn) safariBackBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { try { safariFrame.contentWindow.history.back(); } catch (e) {} });
    if (safariFwd) safariFwd.addEventListener("click", () => { try { safariFrame.contentWindow.history.forward(); } catch (e) {} });
    if (safariReload) safariReload.addEventListener("click", () => { try { safariFrame.src = safariFrame.src; } catch (e) {} });
    document.querySelectorAll('.child-launchpad[data-keywords="Safari"]').forEach(el => {
      el.style.cursor = "pointer";
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const lp = document.getElementById("launchpad");
        if (lp) lp.style.display = "none";
        openSafari();
      });
    });

    
    // Event delegation: Settings always opens on dock / menu click
    document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      const t = e.target;
      if (!t) return;
      const settingsBtn = t.closest && t.closest(".open_settings, .open_settings_menu, [title='System Settings']");
      if (settingsBtn) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (typeof openSettings === "function") openSettings();
        return;
      }
      const safariBtn = t.closest && t.closest(".open_safari, [title='Safari']");
      if (safariBtn && (safariBtn.classList.contains("open_safari") || safariBtn.getAttribute("title")==="Safari")) {
        // only dock/launchpad safari, not random
        if (safariBtn.classList.contains("open_safari") || safariBtn.classList.contains("icon") || safariBtn.classList.contains("child-launchpad")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (typeof openSafari === "function") openSafari();
        }
      }
    }, true);

    
    // Wire context menu wallpaper buttons with direct URLs
    (function wireCtxWallpapers() {
      function run() {
        if (typeof DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS === "undefined") return;
        document.querySelectorAll("#contextMenu button[data-bg]").forEach(btn => {
          const i = parseInt(btn.getAttribute("data-bg"), 10);
          if (DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[i]) {
            btn.setAttribute("data-bg-url", DESKTOP_BACKGROUNDS[i].url);
          }
        });
      }
      run();
      setTimeout(run, 100);
    })();

    

    // ===== Real VS Code (vscode.dev) =====
    let _vscodeLoaded = false;
    let _monacoEditor = null;
    const VSCODE_FILES = {
      "welcome.js": {
        lang: "javascript",
        value: "// Welcome to Visual Studio Code (Monaco Editor)\n// This is a full working code editor running in your browser.\n\nfunction greet(name) {\n  console.log(`Hello, ${name}!`);\n  return `Hello, ${name}!`;\n}\n\ngreet(\"World\");\n\n// Try editing this file, open other files from the sidebar,\n// or create new content. Syntax highlighting and IntelliSense work.\n"
      },
      "app.js": {
        lang: "javascript",
        value: "const express = require(\"express\");\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;\n\napp.get(\"/\", (req, res) => {\n  res.json({ message: \"Hello from the Mac OS web clone\" });\n});\n\napp.listen(PORT, () => {\n  console.log(`Server listening on port ${PORT}`);\n});\n"
      },
      "styles.css": {
        lang: "css",
        value: ":root {\n  --bg: #1e1e1e;\n  --accent: #007acc;\n}\n\nbody {\n  margin: 0;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", sans-serif;\n  background: var(--bg);\n  color: #d4d4d4;\n}\n\n.button {\n  background: var(--accent);\n  color: #fff;\n  border: none;\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n"
      },
      "index.html": {
        lang: "html",
        value: "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"UTF-8\" />\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />\n  <title>My App</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"styles.css\" />\n</head>\n<body>\n  <h1>Hello from VS Code</h1>\n  <button class=\"button\">Click me</button>\n  <script src=\"app.js\"><\/script>\n</body>\n</html>\n"
      },
      "README.md": {
        lang: "markdown",
        value: "# Workspace\n\nThis is a **working** VS Code–style editor powered by [Monaco Editor](https://microsoft.github.io/monaco-editor/) — the same engine that powers Visual Studio Code.\n\n## Features\n- Syntax highlighting\n- Multiple files\n- Status bar\n- Dark theme matching VS Code\n\nEdit any file from the explorer on the left.\n"
      }
    };
    let _currentVsFile = "welcome.js";

    function loadMonaco(cb) {
      if (window.monaco) { cb(); return; }
      if (window._monacoLoading) {
        window._monacoLoading.push(cb);
        return;
      }
      window._monacoLoading = [cb];
      const script = document.createElement("script");
      script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.45.0/min/vs/loader.js";
      script.onload = function() {
        require.config({ paths: { vs: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.45.0/min/vs" } });
        require(["vs/editor/editor.main"], function() {
          const cbs = window._monacoLoading || [];
          window._monacoLoading = null;
          cbs.forEach(fn => { try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); } });
        });
      };
      script.onerror = function() {
        const loading = document.getElementById("vscode-loading");
        if (loading) loading.textContent = "Failed to load editor. Check network.";
        window._monacoLoading = null;
      };
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    function openVsFile(name) {
      const meta = VSCODE_FILES[name];
      if (!meta || !_monacoEditor) return;
      _currentVsFile = name;
      const model = monaco.editor.createModel(meta.value, meta.lang);
      _monacoEditor.setModel(model);
      const langEl = document.getElementById("vscode-status-lang");
      if (langEl) langEl.textContent = meta.lang.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + meta.lang.slice(1);
      document.querySelectorAll(".vscode-file").forEach(el => {
        el.classList.toggle("active", el.dataset.file === name);
      });
      const tabs = document.getElementById("vscode-tabs");
      if (tabs) {
        tabs.innerHTML = '<div class="vscode-tab active" data-file="' + name + '">' + name + ' <span class="tab-x">×</span></div>';
      }
    }

    function initMonacoEditor() {
      const el = document.getElementById("monaco-editor");
      const loading = document.getElementById("vscode-loading");
      if (!el || _monacoEditor) {
        if (loading) loading.classList.add("hidden");
        return;
      }
      _monacoEditor = monaco.editor.create(el, {
        value: VSCODE_FILES["welcome.js"].value,
        language: "javascript",
        theme: "vs-dark",
        automaticLayout: true,
        fontSize: 14,
        minimap: { enabled: true },
        scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
        padding: { top: 8 },
        renderLineHighlight: "line",
        cursorBlinking: "smooth"
      });
      _vscodeLoaded = true;
      if (loading) loading.classList.add("hidden");
      document.querySelectorAll(".vscode-file").forEach(f => {
        f.addEventListener("click", () => openVsFile(f.dataset.file));
      });
    }

    function openVSCode() {
      const win = document.querySelector(".Vscode") || document.getElementById("vscode-window");
      if (!win) return;
      try {
        if (typeof navbar !== "undefined" && navbar) navbar.style.display = "flex";
        if (typeof launchpad !== "undefined" && launchpad) launchpad.style.display = "none";
        if (typeof container !== "undefined" && container) container.style.display = "flex";
      } catch (e) {}
      win.style.display = "flex";
      win.style.zIndex = "50";
      win.classList.add("active");
      if (typeof point_vscode !== "undefined" && point_vscode) point_vscode.style.display = "block";
      if (typeof app_name_VScode !== "undefined" && app_name_VScode) app_name_VScode.style.display = "block";
      try { if (win.parentElement) win.parentElement.appendChild(win); } catch (e) {}
      const loading = document.getElementById("vscode-loading");
      if (loading) loading.classList.remove("hidden");
      loadMonaco(function() {
        initMonacoEditor();
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (_monacoEditor) _monacoEditor.layout();
        }, 50);
      });
    }
    window.openVSCode = openVSCode;
    const open_vscode_btn = document.querySelector(".open_vscode");
    if (open_vscode_btn) {
      open_vscode_btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        openVSCode();
      }, true);
    }

    function lockload() {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const loading = document.getElementById("loading");
        if (loading) loading.style.display = "none";
      }, 700);
    }

    function calculateBattery() {
      let level = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 65;
      if (navigator.getBattery) {
        navigator.getBattery().then(b => {
          level = Math.round(b.level * 100);
          updateBattery(level, b.charging);
        }).catch(() => updateBattery(level, false));
      } else updateBattery(level, false);
    }
    function updateBattery(level, charging) {
      if (batteryText) batteryText.textContent = level + "%";
      if (batteryProgress) batteryProgress.style.width = level + "%";
      if (batteryPopupText) batteryPopupText.textContent = level + "%";
      if (level <= 20 && batteryProgress) batteryProgress.style.background = "var(--color-red)";
      else if (charging && batteryProgress) {
        batteryProgress.style.background = "var(--color-green)";
        if (powerSource) powerSource.textContent = "Power Adapter";
      }
    }
    if (batteryButton) {
      batteryButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (batteryPopup) batteryPopup.classList.toggle("opened");
        batteryButton.classList.toggle("selected");
      });
    }

    // Ensure draggable is set with safe handles
    if (window.jQuery) {
      try {
        $(".terminal, .note, .calculator, .Vscode, .maps, .steam, .spotlight_serach, .settings-window, .safari").draggable({
          handle: ".window__taskbar",
          cancel: "button, input, textarea, a, iframe, .steam-detail-back, #steam-detail-back, #steam-play-back, #steam-detail-play, .steam-play-btn, .lib-game, .game-tile, .wallpaper-card, .settings-sidebar, .steam-nav, .lib-sidebar, .lib-main, .steam-detail-view, .steam-play-view",
          containment: "window"
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
